title: Storm Gladiator
summary: Storm Gladiator is a ghostly Krono-Titan whose body appears as an unearthly blue aura animating a pile of armor.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Storm Gladiator is animated by air and wind. {{Source|TCG:SAS-092|SAS-092}}
sections.text: Storm Gladiator is animated by air and wind. [SAS-092]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Storm Gladiator appears as motionless pile of armor but can animate itself by drawing in nearby air. This unexpected ability lets it move swiftly through enemy lines.

'''Storm Gladiator''' is a ghostly [[Krono-Titan]] whose body appears as an unearthly blue aura animating a pile of armor.

== History ==
Storm Gladiator is animated by air and wind. {{Source|TCG:SAS-092|SAS-092}}

== Abilities ==
Storm Gladiator appears as motionless pile of armor but can animate itself by drawing in nearby air. This unexpected ability lets it move swiftly through enemy lines.
